item.title: Gaza Briefing: June 20, 2026
item.description: Al Jazeera cameraman Ahmed Wishah killed in Israeli strike on Gaza. Multiple outlets reported that Ahmed Wishah, a cameraman for Al Jazeera, was killed in an Israeli strike on a house in the Bureij refugee camp in central Gaza. Transcript and source links are available from The Blue Fern Co.
